recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit for core. If Patient Care wants to revisit request/event causality or stale care-plan narrative in the migrated ClinicalAssessment artifact, open that work against HL7/pc-incubator with FHIR-8463 considered as the later governing decision.
issue_request: Published / Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Patient Care issue asking to remove the specific ClinicalImpression carePlan and referral elements that prompted an assessment and add a trigger element typed as Reference(*) or CodeableConcept for the request or event that necessitated the assessment.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 4782. Imported git history shows the March 2015 ClinicalImpression spreadsheet change replacing careplan/referral search paths with triggerReference/triggerCodeableConcept and setting ClinicalImpression.trigger[x] to CodeableConcept | Reference(Any), matching the resolution intent.
additional_context: FHIR-8463 was a later Published / Persuasive with Modification Patient Care decision to remove ClinicalImpression.trigger because it was unclear whether it meant the trigger for the assessment itself or why the assessment was necessary. Commit ca8df34006 applied that update and removed the trigger element and trigger search parameters. Later cleanup issues such as FHIR-7185 and FHIR-18860 further redesigned the resource. In the current core checkout, source/fhir.ini has no active ClinicalImpression or ClinicalAssessment resource entry, build.fhir.org/clinicalimpression.html returns 404, and source/history.html points the artifact to the Patient Care incubator ClinicalAssessment build.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The seed change was historically applied, later superseded, and any current ClinicalAssessment/ClinicalImpression work belongs outside the active core build, in the Patient Care incubator repository.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Patient Care decision explicitly removed ClinicalImpression.trigger after FHIR-5325 had introduced it.
Later Published ClinicalImpression cleanup renamed action to supportingInfo and clarified ClinicalImpression/Condition boundaries.
Later Published R5 change merged investigation into supportingInfo, showing continued redesign of the artifact after the seed issue.
